gaps.lead: You must sign the form in ink.
gaps.explanation: sign the form in ink → the form must be signed in ink.

gaps.lead: Although he is rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — the inverted concession pattern.

gaps.lead: 'Would you like me to carry that?' he offered.
gaps.explanation: offer to do something: offered to carry.

gaps.lead: It's a pity I didn't bring an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + past perfect — I wish I had brought.

gaps.lead: He is so impatient that he never reads instructions.
gaps.explanation: so impatient that he never reads = too impatient to read.

gaps.lead: People claim that this juice cures colds.
